subject: Nomad Health: private hosting variance + credit ask
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@nomadhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Megan Alvarez <meg.alvarez@nomadhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Private deployment request: audit window and pricing ask

Marissa —

Thanks for the demo last week. Nomad Health is moving faster than expected; our security/compliance team has a couple of asks if we go with Redwood Private: first, we need an explicit 90-day annual audit window with limited on-prem access for our auditors (no continuous full forensic access), and second, because we'll commit to a 12-month reserved capacity plan upfront, we're requesting a 25% credit on hosting fees for year one.

We understand this is non-standard — happy to work within constraints. Can you share what would be necessary from Redwood to make this workable (SLA carveouts, escrow, audit notice periods, etc.)?

Attached: Nomad_RFP_summary.xlsx (excel)

—Sanjay
Sanjay Rao
Head of Security Programs
Nomad Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -04:00
Subject: RE: Private deployment request: audit window and pricing ask

Looping you both in — Nomad (Sanjay/Megan) wants a 90-day annual audit window + a 25% year-one credit for a 12-mo prepay. They’re sensitive about forensic access and want clear notice windows.

My read: business is high intent. We can probably grant a limited audit window and tighten operational guardrails, but 25% is above typical hosted/Dedicated credits. Suggested starting point for approval conversation: 15% one-time credit or a 20% credit tied to a 24-month commit, plus explicit limits:
- Audit window: up to 90 days per 12 months but with a 30-day advance notice; access via a controlled runbook and supervised session (no unsupervised snapshot exports).
- Data residency: locked to US East region; egress controls and HSM for keys.
- Escrow/forensics: enable forensic export only with company security officer signoff and there’s a one-time fee for full forensic support.

Attaching: Nomad_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf) — their SOW and risk list.

Can someone run this with Deal Desk and Ops to confirm constraints we can support and draft a formal concession memo I can send to the customer?

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive, Strategic Deals
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:27:00 -04:00
Subject: RE: Private deployment request: audit window and pricing ask

Marissa —

Thanks for the summary. Operationally, SRE flagged the supervised-runbook approach as acceptable; we should include a maximum of 48 hours/day of on-site engineer time billed if they request hands-on support during the audit.

From a commercial perspective, recommend the following for quick approval:
- 15% one-time credit on year-one hosting for a 12-month prepay (we can stretch to 18% only if they sign a 24-month commit).
- 90-day audit window allowed once per year with 30-day notice; export controls and supervised sessions only.
- Add a clause: Redwood retains right to decline data export requests that violate policy; escalations go to legal.

If Lauren can sign off on 15% + the operational constraints, I think we can close quickly. If they insist on 25%, we should route to CRO for exception.

—Jordan
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:08:00 -04:00
Subject: Fwd: Private deployment request: audit window and pricing ask

Lauren —

Forwarding Nomad ask and our suggested concessions (see thread). Quick context: high-velocity buyer, clinician-facing product with PHI adjacency — legal and security are watching this. Requesting exec okay to offer 15% one-time credit (12-mo prepay) + the guarded audit/forensic language Jordan outlined. Attach the draft concession memo (internal) and their SOW.

Key decision for sign-off: 15% credit + the operational and legal caveats (30-day notice, supervised runbook, Redwood right to decline exports).

If approved I’ll send the formal term sheet and DocuSign link.

Thanks for quick review — we’re aiming to close this week.

—Marissa
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 15:46:00 -04:00
Subject: RE: Private deployment request: audit window and pricing ask

Approved: 15% one-time credit on year-one hosting for a 12-month prepay, subject to the following non‑standard term language to be included in the SOW and MSA addendum:
- Audit window: up to 90 days per 12 months; Redwood will provide supervised sessions and an operations runbook. Customer must provide 30 days advance written notice.
- Forensic/data export: Redwood will permit exports only with written signoff from Nomad’s security officer and Redwood legal; Redwood reserves right to decline exports that breach policy. Any hands-on engineer support requested during the audit will be billed at standard hourly rates beyond the first 48 hours.
- Data residency: production data must remain in US-East; egress requests processed per listed SLAs.

Marissa — please communicate the approved terms to Sanjay/Megan, attach the approved terms PDF, and include the HubSpot deal id and DocuSign link in the message. Jordan/Karthik — please prepare the concession memo and updated SOW with the clauses above.

Lauren Bishop
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
